edits.find: SELECT u.sync_generation, k.generation, k.revision FROM aux_users u LEFT JOIN sync_keys k ON k.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = ${c.get('user').id}
edits.replace: SELECT u.sync_generation, k.generation, k.revision, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aux_sync_recovery_v2 r WHERE r.user_id=u.id AND r.generation=u.sync_generation) AS recovery_configured FROM aux_users u LEFT JOIN sync_keys k ON k.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = ${c.get('user').id}

edits.find: INSERT INTO sync_keys (user_id, generation, wrapped_key) SELECT ${user}, ${account.sync_generation}, ${JSON.stringify(envelope)}::jsonb WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aux_users WHERE id = ${user} AND sync_generation = ${account.sync_generation}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id RETURNING wrapped_key, generation, revision
edits.replace: WITH existing AS (SELECT wrapped_key,generation,revision FROM sync_keys WHERE user_id=${user}), created AS (INSERT INTO sync_keys (user_id,generation,wrapped_key) SELECT ${user},${account.sync_generation},${JSON.stringify(envelope)}::jsonb WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aux_users WHERE id=${user} AND sync_generation=${account.sync_generation}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aux_sync_recovery_v2 WHERE user_id=${user} AND generation=${account.sync_generation}) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING wrapped_key,generation,revision) SELECT * FROM existing UNION ALL SELECT * FROM created LIMIT 1
